name: agent-conversation-mcp
description: AGORA (AgentConversationMCP): local multi-agent MCP conversation hub with a C++23 control core, client hooks, and a bilingual operator web console.

scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix ui install --no-fund --no-audit && npm --prefix ui run build
scripts.test:mcp: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/mcp/transport.spec.mjs test/mcp/interconnect.spec.mjs test/mcp/cli.spec.mjs test/mcp/remote.spec.mjs test/mcp/hook.spec.mjs test/mcp/alerts.spec.mjs test/mcp/tidy.spec.mjs test/mcp/wake.spec.mjs test/mcp/startup.spec.mjs test/mcp/window.spec.mjs test/mcp/dispatch.spec.mjs test/mcp/discover.spec.mjs test/mcp/compact.spec.mjs
